jobs.title: AVP, Program Management and Transformation
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues \- experts in their fields \- who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients \- who are at the heart of everything we do.  



  

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.  



  

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.  



  

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.  



  

**Job Description:**

Reporting to the Vice\-President, HR Business Partner, Digital, Client Experience and Operations Transformation, the AVP, Program Management \& Transformation is a senior leadership role responsible for translating the people and workplace transformation agenda into coordinated, measurable execution across a complex portfolio of business, technology and operations teams.  



  

The role is the central orchestration point for priority people and workplace transformations. It establishes the plans, governance, management routines and cross\-functional accountability required to move work from strategy to sustained delivery, while connecting workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, employee experience, data, talent and change.  



  

This is a high\-impact role for a pragmatic executive leader who combines transformation expertise, disciplined program management, organizational judgment and strong influence without authority.  



Please note this role requires regular presence at our Toronto One York office  



  

**What will you do:**

  

*Transformation Program Leadership \& Enterprise Delivery*

  

* Lead integrated execution across the portfolio's highest\-priority workplace transformation programs, translating strategy into actionable plans with clear outcomes, ownership, milestones and value measures.
* Act as the drumbeat behind delivery, maintaining momentum week over week and proactively identifying risks, dependencies, resource constraints and decisions before they become barriers.
* Coordinate senior leaders, HRBPs, Centres of Expertise, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Data and Analytics, Technology and business workstream owners to align priorities and resolve blockers without direct authority.
* Establish fit\-for\-purpose governance, decision forums, risk registers, integrated roadmaps and escalation paths that accelerate execution while preserving appropriate people and risk considerations.

Monitor progress against strategic commitments and provide executive\-level recommendations on priorities, trade\-offs and interventions required.  

* 

  

*OKR Governance, Performance \& Measurement*

  

* Design and lead a connected OKR governance approach spanning Canadian business units, functions and HR, with clear standards, cadences, ownership and escalation mechanisms.
* Connect OKRs to the enterprise metrics agenda and performance culture, building the capability and tools leaders need to set high\-quality objectives and use data to improve performance.
* Define value measures across workstreams, integrating workforce, organizational health, employee experience and business indicators into a trusted view of delivery.

Develop executive dashboards, portfolio reviews and management routines that create transparency, surface root causes and drive timely corrective action.  

* 

*Workforce Strategy \& People Process Alignment*

  

* Lead cross\-business workforce planning grounded in labour supply and demand, capability gaps and build\-versus\-buy choices, with short\-, medium\- and long\-term talent requirements.
* Partner with HRBPs, Talent Acquisition and Finance to assess hiring pipeline health, fill\-rate risks and talent investment effectiveness, and sponsor targeted improvement initiatives.
* Align role, level, compensation and talent evaluation approaches to external technology and AI markets while maintaining enterprise consistency.

Integrate workforce transition and capability\-building plans into transformation roadmaps, connecting the work to enterprise Talent mechanisms.  

* 

*Employee Experience, Change \& Ways of Working*

  

* Embed employee experience and data and analytics into program design, using evidence to understand workforce needs, anticipate friction and improve adoption and outcomes.
* Lead the change approach for complex transformations, including stakeholder segmentation, communications, readiness, transition support and sustained adoption.
* Assess the cumulative impact of change on leaders, teams and HR, and sequence work to protect delivery capacity, employee trust and business continuity.

Advance new ways of working across the Canadian organization, simplifying how work moves across organizational boundaries and strengthening accountability, pace and collaboration.  

* 

*Executive Partnership \& Organizational Enablement*

  

* Serve as a trusted advisor to the VP HRBP and senior business and HR leaders, bringing structured problem solving, sound judgment and a clear enterprise perspective to ambiguous issues.
* Define effective connection points with Strategy and Enablement, Employee Experience, Data and Analytics, Talent and other HR capabilities so accountability is clear and work is integrated end to end.
* Prepare concise, decision\-oriented materials for the VP HRBP, CHRO, senior leadership and governance forums, translating complex work into clear implications and recommendati

jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Director, People and Culture Strategy
  
**Employment Type:** Permanent
  
**Existing Vacancy:** Yes
  
**Division/Branch:** People and Culture Division / People and Culture Strategy
  
**Application Deadline:** October 9, 2026
  
**Pay Level:** 13
  
**Pay Range:** $149,307 to $186,631
  
**Work Location:** Head Office, Toronto, ON; (In\-Office)
  
  

The Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario (AGCO) is an agency where innovation thrives, ideas flourish, and passion drives us to new heights of excellence. Reporting to the Ministry of the Attorney General, the AGCO is responsible for regulating Ontario’s vibrant alcohol, gaming, horse racing, and private retail cannabis sectors in accordance with the principles of honesty and integrity, and in the public interest.
  
  

The Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario (AGCO) is seeking a strategic, collaborative and forward\-thinking leader to serve as Director, People and Culture Strategy. Reporting to the Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), the Director People and Culture Strategy provides enterprise leadership for People and Culture strategy, transformation and modernization, with responsibility for advancing the People Strategic Plan, divisional priorities, enterprise metrics and executive reporting, HR digital enablement, responsible AI adoption, diversity, inclusion and accessibility (DI\&A), inclusive leadership and high\-performing team leadership.
  
  

This role translates enterprise and divisional priorities into practical strategies, roadmaps, implementation plans, performance measures and governance mechanisms that strengthen organizational readiness, workforce planning, evidence\-based decision\-making and measurable impact across AGCO.
  
  

The ideal candidate is a trusted strategic advisor who brings strong judgment, systems thinking and a collaborative leadership style. They are comfortable operating in a complex public\-sector environment, balancing long\-term transformation with immediate operational priorities, and translating data, risk, workforce trends and stakeholder needs into practical, inclusive and measurable people strategies.
  
  

If you are motivated by the opportunity to lead strategic HR transformation, advance responsible digital and AI adoption, strengthen diversity, inclusion and accessibility, and support a strong employee experience, this role offers a meaningful platform to make a lasting enterprise\-wide contribution at AGCO.
  
  

**What You Will Do:**  

* Lead the development, implementation and ongoing refresh of AGCO’s People Strategic Plan, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities, government mandates, workforce risks and evolving organizational needs.
* Translate organizational priorities into actionable people strategies, roadmaps, initiatives, performance measures and implementation plans.
* Oversee the planning, prioritization and delivery of People and Culture initiatives, projects and divisional priorities that advance organizational goals.
* Establish planning, governance, reporting and accountability mechanisms to monitor progress against strategic commitments and demonstrate measurable impact.
* Provide strategic advice to the CHRO, C\-Suite, senior leaders and governance committees on HR priorities, workforce implications, transformation risks and organizational readiness.
* Design and oversee enterprise People and Culture performance indicators, dashboards, workforce analytics and executive reporting to support transparency, accountability and evidence\-informed decision\-making.
* Lead HR digital enablement and responsible AI adoption by developing practical capability, governance practices and high\-value use cases that improve service quality, efficiency and decision\-making.
* Provide enterprise leadership for DI\&A strategy, accessibility and inclusive leadership, embedding inclusion principles into AGCO culture, operations and people practices.
* Lead the refresh, implementation and evaluation of enterprise DI\&A strategy, including the development and reporting of meaningful performance measures.
* Act as a senior subject matter expert on DI\&A and accessibility, advising executives and senior leaders on inclusive talent practices, cultural transformation and emerging obligations.
* Provide leadership and direction to a team by setting clear expectations, prioritizing deliverables, supporting development and fostering a culture of inclusion, accountability, learning and high


**You Have:**  

* Post\-secondary education in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Organizational Psychology, Adult Education, Strategic Planning, Leadership, Human Rights, Public Policy or a related field, or equivalent work experience; a master’s degree is considered an asset.
* Minimum of 8 years progressive leadership experience in strategic planning, organizational transformation, HR strategy, performance measurement, workforce analytics, DI\&A, accessibility, digital enablement and/or related areas.
* Demonstrated ability to translate enterprise priorities into practical strategies, roadmaps, governance structures, implementation plans and measurable outcomes.
* Strong understanding of HR digital adoption, HRIS\-enabled process improvement, workflow automation, workforce analytics, digital service delivery, change management and responsible AI use.
* Knowledge of HR data governance, privacy, accessibility, security, records management and ethical use of workforce information.
* Experience developing executive\-level reports, dashboards, briefings and presentations that translate complex information into clear insights and recommendations.
* Strong consultation, facilitation, public speaking and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence and build alignment across senior leaders, governance bodies and cross\-functional partners.
* Demonstrated experience leading DI\&A strategy, accessibility initiatives, inclusive leadership development,

jobs.title: Sr Director, Operations Finance
jobs.description:
**Department:** Finance
  
**Reports to:** Vice President, Business Finance
  
**Status:** Full\-time
  
**Location:** Hybrid/Head office (10 Carlson Court, Etobicoke)
  
Purpose
  
Gay Lea is modernizing its finance function to better support enterprise decision\-making, performance, and growth. This includes reducing manual reporting, strengthening planning processes, and leveraging improved tools and data capabilities.
  
This role is accountable for the financial performance of the manufacturing network, partnering with Operations to improve profitability through better manufacturing performance, asset utilization, and cost management.
  
The role owns costing methodology and manufacturing cost standards across the network and leads the plant controller community in delivering consistent financial visibility and performance management across all sites.
  
As a senior business partner to Operations leadership, the role converts plant and network data into operational decisions, surfaces cost and capacity trade\-offs, and shifts site finance effort from reporting to decision support.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Partner with Operations to improve profitability through manufacturing performance, asset utilization, and cost management
* Support manufacturing decisions through financial analysis of costs, productivity, capacity, and investments
* Develop consistent costing methodologies, BOM governance, and manufacturing cost standards across the network
* Lead financial visibility and performance management across manufacturing operations and site performance
* Own the Finance contribution to the Supply Review within Integrated Business Planning (IBP), translating capacity, utilization, cost, and inventory decisions into financial outcomes
* Evaluate operational trade\-offs and support decisions that improve both financial and operational outcomes and communicate accordingly with other stakeholders
* Monitor performance against commitments and identify risks, opportunities, and corrective actions
* Partner with Operations to improve performance measurement, processes, tools, and operational insights
* Lead, develop, and set standards for the plant controller team across the manufacturing network
* Shift finance effort from reporting to decision support by leveraging data, tools, and improved ways of working


Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree in finance/accounting; CPA and/or MBA preferred
* Proven finance leadership experience in Manufacturing, Operations Finance, or Plant Controllership environments
* 10\+ years in finance with significant experience in cost accounting and multi\-site manufacturing
* Deep understanding of standard costing, BOM governance, variance analysis, and capital evaluation
* Demonstrated ability to influence operating leaders and operate at the enterprise level
* Experience leading distributed or multi\-site finance teams
* Ability to operate effectively with ambiguity and make meaningful trade\-offs
* Direct, pragmatic, and outcome\-focused leadership style
* Advanced financial, analytical, and systems capabilities


Gay Lea Foods is a Canadian, dairy farmer owned co operative with a clear purpose: to enrich life with dairy. Founded in 1958, the co operative produces high quality dairy products while creating lasting value for farming families, meaningful opportunities for employees, and positive impact in communities across Canada. As a co operative, Gay Lea Foods believes that when the business succeeds, its members, people, and communities should succeed along with it. To learn more, visit gaylea.com.
  
Gay Lea Foods is an equal\-opportunity employer and values diversity in our workplace.
  
Reasonable accommodation is available upon request throughout our recruitment and selection process.
  
Gay Lea Foods may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support aspects of the recruitment process, including screening and assessment.
  
We are currently accepting applications for this open position.
  
Thank you for your interest in Gay Lea Foods.
  
Wishing you all the best with your career search!

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Business Intelligence and Analytics
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

The Senior Director, Business Intelligence and Analytics is a senior enterprise leader responsible for building and leading GS1 Canada’s business intelligence, analytics, and market insight capability. The role gives the organization a clear, trusted, and evidence\-based view of strategic performance, subscriber growth and retention, product and service adoption, sector opportunity, and emerging market dynamics.  

The role leads a team of analysts and market intelligence professionals who measure organizational performance, identify growth opportunities, assess subscriber and sector trends, and translate data into clear recommendations for senior leadership. The function will move beyond traditional reporting toward predictive, decision\-oriented analytics that explain what is happening, why it matters, what is likely to happen next, and where action is required.  

A central mandate is to transform the analytics function through the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence. This leader will establish the roadmap, operating model, capabilities, and governance needed to embed AI into analytical workflows; improve the speed, quality, and reach of insight; and equip the team and business leaders to use AI effectively and responsibly.
  

The role translates GS1 Canada’s enterprise strategy into measurable outcomes, owns the enterprise KPI and performance framework, and ensures executives and business leaders receive timely, consistent, and decision\-ready insight. It partners closely with Product, Subscriber Management, Finance, Marketing, Industry Relations, Community Engagement, Technology, Operations, Data Governance, Privacy, Cybersecurity, and the AI Council.  

This is a high\-impact, enterprise\-facing leadership role requiring analytical judgment, strategic thinking, executive communication, change leadership, people development, and### **Key Responsibilities**

 **Build and Lead the Business Intelligence and Analytics Function*** Build, lead, and mature GS1 Canada’s business intelligence and analytics capability, including enterprise reporting, subscriber and sector analytics, product and service usage analytics, market intelligence, and growth insights.
* Establish a trusted and consistent single version of the truth by aligning data definitions, metrics, dashboards, and reports across business units
* Lead enterprise dashboards, executive scorecards, and recurring insight products covering subscriber growth, retention, churn, adoption, engagement, service usage, sector penetration, revenue performance, and strategic execution.
* Advance the function from descriptive reporting to diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive insight that identifies drivers, anticipates risks and opportunities, and recommends action.
* Establish standards for analytical quality, metric definitions, dashboard governance, documentation, reproducibility, and executive communication.
* Partner with Technology, Data Governance, and business teams to improve data accessibility, quality, reliability, and fitness for analytical and AI use.

**Lead Subscriber, Sector and Market Intelligence*** Build an integrated intelligence capability that combines subscriber and operational data, sector insight, competitive intelligence, and external market trends.
* Monitor changes in subscriber expectations, digital and agentic commerce, product data management, regulation, sustainability, 2D barcode adoption, AI\-enabled data management, and other developments affecting GS1 Canada’s relevance and growth.
* Synthesize quantitative and qualitative signals from sector boards, working groups, subscriber interactions, support channels, research, and industry forums in partnership with relevant business teams.
* Identify enterprise\-wide patterns and sector\-specific needs, and provide regular executive briefings on market shifts, subscriber expectations, competitors, opportunities, and strategic risks.
* Recommend where insights indicate a need to adjust strategic focus, product priorities, positioning, education, or market engagement.

**Own the Enterprise KPI and Measurement Framework*** Define and maintain the enterprise KPI framework, aligned to strategy, subscriber value, growth, adoption, financial performance, and operational outcomes.
* Set consistent definitions and ownership for core measures, including subscriber growth, retention, churn, engagement, adoption, product and service usage, sector penetration, revenue trends, and strategic progress
* Partner with Finance and functional leaders to ensure measures are reliable, decision\-useful, and consistently applied across executive, functional, and sector reporting.
* Identify gaps or inconsistencies in measurement and recommend improvements to data, instrumentation, reporting, and accountability.
* Focus leadership attention on the few measures that matter most, connecting activity to subscriber outcomes, growth impact, and strategic value.

**Lead the AI\-Enabled Transformation of Analytics*** Develop and execute a multi\-year roadmap to transform the analytics function through AI, aligned with enterprise strategy, the AI Council, and GS1 Canada’s technology and data priorities.
* Prioritize high\-value use cases such as automated data preparation and reporting, insight synthesis, anomaly detection, forecasting, segmentation, churn and propensity analysis, and conversational or self\-service analytics.
* Redesign analyst workflows and roles to combine automation with human judgment, enabling the team to spend less time producing reports and more time interpreting results, advising leaders, and driving action.
* Establish a disciplined path from experimentation to production, including use\-case intake, value assessment, pilots, validation, adoption planning, controls, and scaling.
* Partner with Technology and Data Governance on approved tools, architecture, secure data access, semantic models, data quality, integration, and producti

**Job Description**

**What is the Opportunity?**

This is an opportunity to lead the Data, AI, KYC and Specialized Business portfolio within RBC Caribbean Banking Technology, a team dedicated to delivering modern, resilient solutions for our Caribbean businesses and clients. We are all in on Agile delivery, DevOps, open source, cloud and modern engineering practices, and the work is highly visible: our applications are used daily by RBC staff and clients across the region.


Reporting to the Senior Director, the Director owns three connected mandates. First, the modernization of the Caribbean data foundation: evolving the data lake, data architecture and data products so that the business can trust and use its data. Second, AI engineering: building and operating production grade AI solutions for clients and colleagues, from generative and agentic AI to intelligent automation, with responsible AI and regulatory controls built in. Third, software development and delivery for KYC and Specialized Business Applications: leading the engineering team accountable for a portfolio of vendor applications and for active development of the KYC platform, and delivering the associated project portfolio on time and with quality.


The successful candidate combines hands on technical credibility in data and AI engineering with proven project delivery, vendor management and people leadership, and a clear understanding of the banking industry’s data, processes and regulatory obligations. They are comfortable navigating ambiguity and leading in a fast paced, rapidly evolving technology environment.

 **What Will You Do?**

 **Data modernization and data foundation**

* Own end to end delivery of data engineering and data product initiatives for the Caribbean, working closely with business and technology stakeholders to define scope, priorities and expectations.
* Lead the data modernization roadmap and architecture, retire legacy data flows, and establish the platform as the standard foundation for analytics, reporting, consolidation of siloed data, removal of duplicated data profiles, and AI solutions.
* Establish and enforce data governance practices (data dictionary, lineage, quality and access controls) that meet regulatory and audit expectations across Caribbean jurisdictions.
* Mature CI/CD and orchestration for data pipelines, with automated testing, monitoring and service level objectives for production data.
* Partner with business lines to define data products and self service capabilities that create measurable value.

**AI engineering and AI solutions**

* Define, communicate and execute the AI solutions roadmap for Caribbean applications, aligned to the business vision and to emerging AI capabilities (generative AI, agentic AI, large language models, intelligent process automation).
* Build and grow an AI engineering practice: design, develop, deploy and operate production ready AI solutions for clients and colleagues, well integrated with existing Caribbean systems and data infrastructure.
* Establish the engineering foundations for AI at scale: reusable patterns for LLM integration, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), agent orchestration, evaluation and testing frameworks, prompt and context management, and an AI asset registry with versioning.
* Lead operational support for AI solutions in production: monitoring and observability, incident management, logging, performance tuning, drift and quality detection, and AIOps.
* Champion ethical and responsible AI: ensure all initiatives comply with RBC policies and regulatory requirements applicable to banking in Canada and the Caribbean (e.g., OSFI guidance, model risk management, privacy legislation), and partner with Risk, Compliance and Legal on approvals.
* Stay abreast of AI advancements, evaluate their applicability to the Caribbean banking context, and act as an internal thought leader on applied AI.

**Software development and delivery: KYC and Specialized Business Applications**

* Lead the software development team accountable for a portfolio of vendor applications supporting Specialized Business functions, including release management, configuration, integration, upgrades, incident response and production support.
* Lead active development of the KYC platform: own the backlog, architecture direction, engineering quality, security and delivery cadence, in close partnership with AML/Compliance and Operations stakeholders.
* Manage vendor relationships and service ownership: contracts and SLAs, roadmap alignment, escalations and performance reviews.
* Deliver the project portfolio through disciplined Agile delivery (planning, dependency and risk management, status reporting and executive communication) with accountability for scope, schedule, budget and quality.
* Embed modern engineering practices (DevOps, automation, CI/CD, automated testing) to improve resilience, reduce operational risk and cost, and strengthen security and availability.
* Ensure disaster recovery, uptime and resilience for all production systems in the portfolio.

**Leadership and stakeholder engagement**

* Lead, mentor and grow a high performing, cross regional team of data engineers, AI engineers and software developers across Toronto and the Caribbean, fostering technical excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement.

* Contribute to the Senior Director’s broader technology strategy and represent the portfolio in governance forums.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**What is the opportunity?**


At RBC Insurance, AI is fundamental to transforming how we operate, serve our customers, and compete in a rapidly evolving financial services landscape. To realize this opportunity, we need a visionary leader who can simultaneously architect and enable enterprise AI capabilities, modernize and enhance our data platforms, and transform our legacy integration infrastructure into a nimble, scalable foundation.


As Senior Director, AI and Data \& Integration Platforms, you will own the strategy and end\-to\-end delivery across all three domains. You'll be responsible for building the intelligent, data\-driven foundation that enables RBC Insurance to unlock AI\-driven intelligence to enhance customer experiences, and fundamentally transform our business model. This is your opportunity to lead one of the most consequential technology transformations in our organization's history.

 **What will you do?**

  

* Own enterprise AI strategy and delivery: Develop and execute the long\-term vision for AI capabilities across RBC Insurance IT and business operations. Identify frontier, game\-changing AI use cases that drive competitive advantage, serve as the expert for emerging AI technologies, and position RBC Insurance as an AI\-first organization.
* Architect and modernize data platforms: Lead the strategic transformation of our global data foundation, stabilizing and enhancing both on\-premises and cloud data platforms. Build a scalable, secure, resilient data architecture that serves as the foundation for AI, analytics, and business intelligence. Ensure data governance, quality, and accessibility across the enterprise while optimizing cost and performance.
* Transform legacy integration platforms: Champion the modernization of our integration infrastructure, moving from legacy systems to API\-first, event\-driven architectures. Design integration platforms that enable seamless data flow, real\-time decision\-making, and agile business capability delivery.
* Drive strategy into delivery at scale: Translate strategic vision into executable roadmaps and quarterly milestones. Lead end\-to\-end execution of transformational initiatives spanning AI implementation, data platform migration, and integration modernization. Establish accountability for delivery excellence, quality, and measurable business outcomes.
* Build and lead high\-performing teams: Provide strategic leadership to data architects, AI engineers, integration specialists, and technical teams. Foster a high\-performance culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Coach technical leaders on strategic thinking, delivery excellence, and career development. Build a team of thought leaders who stay at the forefront of AI, data, and integration technologies.
* Build strategic partnerships and stakeholder alignment: Serve as the trusted delivery partner to business leaders, IT executives, and technology teams. Cultivate strong relationships across Technology, Digital Channels, Business Operations, and Product teams. Align organizational priorities, remove obstacles, and drive speed to impact through collaborative leadership..
* Champion continuous learning: Cultivate a team of technical thought leaders who stay at the forefront of industry trends, emerging technologies, and digital platform best practices, ensuring RBC Insurance maintains competitive advantage and drives innovation across digital channels.

**Must Have**

* 10\+ years of progressive leadership in AI, data, and/or technology transformation, with 5\+ years leading technical teams delivering enterprise\-scale IT solutions. Demonstrated track record of executing transformational business strategy and delivering measurable organizational impact.

Strong understanding of GenAI and Agentic AI applications across business operations, including predictive analytics, automation, and intelligent decision\-making. Ability to translate AI capabilities into business value and organizational efficiencies.
* Expert\-level data platform leadership: Extensive experience designing, building, and modernizing enterprise data platforms (data lakes, data warehouses, cloud platforms). Proficiency with both legacy and modern data technologies. Strong foundation in data governance, quality, integration, and analytics.
* Integration platform and modernization expertise: Experience leading the transformation of legacy integration infrastructure to modern architectures. Deep understanding of API\-first design, event\-driven systems, and hybrid technology ecosystems
* Enterprise delivery and execution excellence: Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi\-year transformational programs at enterprise scale within financial institutions or regulated industries. Strong foundation in software development lifecycle, budgeting, resource allocation, and delivery governance.
* Executive leadership and stakeholder influence: Exceptional ability to lead diverse technical teams and influence senior stakeholders through data\-driven decision\-making, compelling communication, and strategic facilitation. Strong executive presence and ability to operate at the C\-level.

* Prior experience in financial services or regulated industries, with deep understanding of compliance, risk management, and enterprise governance frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience with specific AI/ML platforms (e.g., cloud AI services, Agentic AI, LLMs, GenAI, MCP, etc), modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake), and integration technologies (e.g. Apache Kafka, APIGee, event streaming, etc).

$180\-$195K

Actual offers may differ based on experience, market conditions, and other relevant factors. The range does not include additional compensation such as bonuses, equity, benefits, or other incentives.


**Who We Need**

Reporting to the Vice President, Marketing Communications, we are hiring a Director, Brand \& Content Strategy to lead the development and execution of Altus Group’s global brand narrative and content strategy. IPEX is one of North America’s leading providers of advanced plastic piping systems. Our mission is to shape a better tomorrow by connecting people with water and energy.  



  

We currently have an exciting opportunity as a **Director, Data Center Strategy \& Market Development** This role is based is a hybrid in office Oakville, Ontario and reports to the Vice President, Transformation Office.  



  

Do not miss the opportunity to join a diverse group of people\-centric professionals, thought leaders, and rapid thinkers—entrepreneurs in spirit and status quo‑fighters.  



  

**Job Summary:**

  

The Director, Data Center Strategy \& Market Development – North America will lead the development and execution of IPEX’s strategy to capture the rapidly growing data center opportunity across Canada and the United States.  



  

Operating across IPEX’s traditional market segments, the Director will take an end\-to\-end view of the data center ecosystem, identifying where IPEX can create value across site infrastructure, building systems, cooling, water treatment and other emerging applications. The Director will define where IPEX should compete, develop the value proposition and portfolio roadmap required to win, and mobilize the organization behind a clear multi\-year growth plan.  



  

A critical component of the role will be developing relationships and influence with hyperscalers, colocation providers, engineering and design firms, developers, contractors, technology partners and other key decision\-makers. The Director will work to position IPEX earlier in the design and specification process and increase the adoption of IPEX solutions within data center projects.  



  

The role will be supported by a cross\-functional team spanning Sales, Product Management, Innovation, Technical,Codes \& Standards, Marketing and Operations **.**

  

**Principal Responsibilities**

  

* Develop and own IPEX's North American data center strategy, defining priority applications, customers, geographies, technologies and routes to market and translating these into a multi\-year growth roadmap.
* Build an end\-to\-end view of the opportunity across site infrastructure, building systems, cooling systems, water treatment and other relevant applications, connecting opportunities across IPEX's existing segments and portfolios.
* Develop deep understanding of the data center ecosystem and build senior relationships with hyperscale’s, colocation providers, engineers, developers, contractors and technology partners to understand requirements and influence material and system decisions.
* Position IPEX upstream in the specification and design process, partnering with Technical and Codes \& Standards to influence specifications, standards and acceptance of IPEX solutions.
* Assess IPEX's current portfolio against evolving data center requirements and identify product, technology and capability gaps, recommending new product development, partnerships or other solutions required to compete.
* Develop differentiated value propositions and solution positioning for priority applications, including mission\-critical cooling and water\-management systems.
* Maintain strong awareness of emerging data center technologies and design trends, including direct liquid cooling, facility and technology cooling systems, water efficiency and evolving infrastructure requirements, and translate these into implications for IPEX.
* Lead the cross\-functional data center team, aligning Sales, Product Management, Innovation, Technical, Codes \& Standards, Marketing and Operations around common priorities and execution plans.
* Build market intelligence on project pipelines, competitors, technologies and customer requirements and translate insights into commercial priorities and investment recommendations.
* Establish KPIs and regularly communicate progress, pipeline, strategic opportunities, risks and investment requirements to senior leadership.

  

Measures of Success


* Clear North American data center strategy and multi\-year growth roadmap established and executed.
* Strong relationships developed with priority hyperscalers, colocation providers, engineering firms and other specification influencers.
* Increased IPEX inclusion in data center designs and specifications.
* Measurable pipeline and profitable incremental revenue generated across multiple IPEX segments.
* Priority product and capability gaps identified and addressed through innovation, partnerships or portfolio development.
* Differentiated IPEX value propositions established for priority applications, including cooling and water\-management solutions.
* Cross\-functional resources aligned around a common set of data center priorities.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing or a related discipline; advanced degree considered an asset.
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in data centers, mission\-critical infrastructure, building systems, cooling/HVAC, industrial systems, market development, product management or related fields.
* Prior experience within the data center ecosystem strongly preferred, with demonstrated understanding of how hyperscalers, colocation providers, engineers and other stakeholders influence design, specification and purchasing decisions.
* Existing relationships within the data center owner/operator, engineering, design or technology ecosystem would be a significant asset.
* Ability to travel regularly throughout Canada and the United States.

new_jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues \- experts in their fields \- who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients \- who are at the heart of everything we do.  



  

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.  



  

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.  



  

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.  



  

**Job Description:**

Reporting to the Vice\-President, HR Business Partner, Digital, Client Experience and Operations Transformation, the AVP, Program Management \& Transformation is a senior leadership role responsible for translating the people and workplace transformation agenda into coordinated, measurable execution across a complex portfolio of business, technology and operations teams.  



  

The role is the central orchestration point for priority people and workplace transformations. It establishes the plans, governance, management routines and cross\-functional accountability required to move work from strategy to sustained delivery, while connecting workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, employee experience, data, talent and change.  



  

This is a high\-impact role for a pragmatic executive leader who combines transformation expertise, disciplined program management, organizational judgment and strong influence without authority.  



Please note this role requires regular presence at our Toronto One York office  



  

**What will you do:**

  

*Transformation Program Leadership \& Enterprise Delivery*

  

* Lead integrated execution across the portfolio's highest\-priority workplace transformation programs, translating strategy into actionable plans with clear outcomes, ownership, milestones and value measures.
* Act as the drumbeat behind delivery, maintaining momentum week over week and proactively identifying risks, dependencies, resource constraints and decisions before they become barriers.
* Coordinate senior leaders, HRBPs, Centres of Expertise, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Data and Analytics, Technology and business workstream owners to align priorities and resolve blockers without direct authority.
* Establish fit\-for\-purpose governance, decision forums, risk registers, integrated roadmaps and escalation paths that accelerate execution while preserving appropriate people and risk considerations.

Monitor progress against strategic commitments and provide executive\-level recommendations on priorities, trade\-offs and interventions required.  

* 

  

*OKR Governance, Performance \& Measurement*

  

* Design and lead a connected OKR governance approach spanning Canadian business units, functions and HR, with clear standards, cadences, ownership and escalation mechanisms.
* Connect OKRs to the enterprise metrics agenda and performance culture, building the capability and tools leaders need to set high\-quality objectives and use data to improve performance.
* Define value measures across workstreams, integrating workforce, organizational health, employee experience and business indicators into a trusted view of delivery.

Develop executive dashboards, portfolio reviews and management routines that create transparency, surface root causes and drive timely corrective action.  

* 

*Workforce Strategy \& People Process Alignment*

  

* Lead cross\-business workforce planning grounded in labour supply and demand, capability gaps and build\-versus\-buy choices, with short\-, medium\- and long\-term talent requirements.
* Partner with HRBPs, Talent Acquisition and Finance to assess hiring pipeline health, fill\-rate risks and talent investment effectiveness, and sponsor targeted improvement initiatives.
* Align role, level, compensation and talent evaluation approaches to external technology and AI markets while maintaining enterprise consistency.

Integrate workforce transition and capability\-building plans into transformation roadmaps, connecting the work to enterprise Talent mechanisms.  

* 

*Employee Experience, Change \& Ways of Working*

  

* Embed employee experience and data and analytics into program design, using evidence to understand workforce needs, anticipate friction and improve adoption and outcomes.
* Lead the change approach for complex transformations, including stakeholder segmentation, communications, readiness, transition support and sustained adoption.
* Assess the cumulative impact of change on leaders, teams and HR, and sequence work to protect delivery capacity, employee trust and business continuity.

Advance new ways of working across the Canadian organization, simplifying how work moves across organizational boundaries and strengthening accountability, pace and collaboration.  

* 

*Executive Partnership \& Organizational Enablement*

  

* Serve as a trusted advisor to the VP HRBP and senior business and HR leaders, bringing structured problem solving, sound judgment and a clear enterprise perspective to ambiguous issues.
* Define effective connection points with Strategy and Enablement, Employee Experience, Data and Analytics, Talent and other HR capabilities so accountability is clear and work is integrated end to end.
* Prepare concise, decision\-oriented materials for the VP HRBP, CHRO, senior leadership and governance forums, translating complex work into clear implications and recommendati

### **Description**

  

The Senior Director, Business Intelligence and Analytics is a senior enterprise leader responsible for building and leading GS1 Canada’s business intelligence, analytics, and market insight capability. The role gives the organization a clear, trusted, and evidence\-based view of strategic performance, subscriber growth and retention, product and service adoption, sector opportunity, and emerging market dynamics.  

The role leads a team of analysts and market intelligence professionals who measure organizational performance, identify growth opportunities, assess subscriber and sector trends, and translate data into clear recommendations for senior leadership. The function will move beyond traditional reporting toward predictive, decision\-oriented analytics that explain what is happening, why it matters, what is likely to happen next, and where action is required.  

A central mandate is to transform the analytics function through the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence. This leader will establish the roadmap, operating model, capabilities, and governance needed to embed AI into analytical workflows; improve the speed, quality, and reach of insight; and equip the team and business leaders to use AI effectively and responsibly.

* Synthesize quantitative and qualitative signals from sector boards, working groups, subscriber interactions, support channels, research, and industry forums in partnership with relevant business teams.
* Identify enterprise\-wide patterns and sector\-specific needs, and provide regular executive briefings on market shifts, subscriber expectations, competitors, opportunities, and strategic risks.
* Recommend where insights indicate a need to adjust strategic focus, product priorities, positioning, education, or market engagement.

* Set consistent definitions and ownership for core measures, including subscriber growth, retention, churn, engagement, adoption, product and service usage, sector penetration, revenue trends, and strategic progress
* Partner with Finance and functional leaders to ensure measures are reliable, decision\-useful, and consistently applied across executive, functional, and sector reporting.
* Identify gaps or inconsistencies in measurement and recommend improvements to data, instrumentation, reporting, and accountability.
* Focus leadership attention on the few measures that matter most, connecting activity to subscriber outcomes, growth impact, and strategic value.
